source_abilities.name: Steadfast Stance
source_abilities.description:
Grants Steadfast Stance.
When targeting a party member, rush to their side, granting both you and the target Steadfast Stance.
Steadfast Stance Effect: Grants a barrier that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum HP
Duration: 30s
